cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James' CEO describes three buckets for how it thinks about AI: supporting infrastructure, resiliency and cybersecurity; increasing efficiency and consistency of service; and helping financial advisors and bankers provide more bespoke and tailored advice to a larger number of clients.
items.quote: The first is to support our infrastructure, the resiliency, the cybersecurity apparatus... Secondly, increasing efficiency and consistency of service... Finally, is to help our financial advisors and bankers provide more bespoke and tailored advice to a larger number of clients.

items.text: Raymond James launched a proprietary digital AI operations agent named Rai that builds on its service-focused AI strategy.
items.quote: Highlighting this is our newly launched proprietary digital AI operations agent named Rai, which builds on our service-focused, long-term AI strategy.

items.text: Raymond James is piloting an AI-powered advisor assistant called Raimond, trained on approximately one million recorded calls between advisors and the firm's service center.
items.quote: is piloting an AI-powered advisor assistant called Raimond, which Shoukry has said was trained on approximately one million recorded calls between advisors and the firm's service center.

items.text: Raymond James established and filled a Chief AI Officer role and rolled out an in-house proprietary AI search tool to help financial professionals serve clients more effectively and efficiently.
items.quote: during the quarter, we established and filled a new role for the Chief AI Officer... we rolled out an in-house proprietary AI search tool, which has been very well received.

items.text: Raymond James says AI will not replace advisers; advisers who use AI will replace advisers who do not, and its goal is to ensure all advisers have access to and expertise in using AI to better serve clients.
items.quote: We say to our advisers, AI will not replace advisers. Advisers who use AI will replace advisers who do not use AI.

items.text: According to Capgemini's World Wealth Report, technology will handle research and complexity while advisors focus on judgment, empathy, and guiding clients through decisions; realtime intelligence elevates advisor impact by providing timely insights into client behavior, preferences, and emerging needs.
items.quote: Technology will handle research and complexity, while advisors focus on judgment, empathy, and guiding clients through decisions that matter most.

items.text: Schwab plans to leverage AI to allow reps to focus on deepening relationships through an enhanced advisor workstation, AI-enabled workflows, and 'pre-advice' experiences to anticipate advice needs.
items.quote: Leverage AI to allow reps to focus on deepening relationships... Enhanced advisor workstation... AI-enabled workflows... 'Pre-advice' experiences to anticipate advice needs

items.text: Bank of America's GWIM segment benefits from new AI-enabled tools that help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale.
items.quote: growing digital engagement and new AI-enabled tools that help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale.

items.text: At Bank of America, AI is helping relationship managers and advisors search and summarize information, preparing them to deliver personalized planning and pitches; copilots help them organize the prospecting process.
items.quote: AI is helping those relationship managers and advisors search and summarize information, preparing them to deliver personalized planning and personalized pitches... Copilots help them organize the prospecting process

items.text: Bank of America presents AI-generated 'Client Insights' where client needs are proactively surfaced to advisors through integrated data sources and AI-powered systems, with an estimated 50% time reduction.
items.quote: Client needs are proactively surfaced to advisors through integrated data sources and AIpowered systems

items.text: Schwab describes a capability that uses AI to quickly summarize past client interactions before a client meeting, share a view on helpful actions, record the meeting and prepare an action-based summary.
items.quote: this capability quickly summarizes past client interactions using AI, shares a view on actions that would help the client, records the client meeting and prepares an action-based summary of the meeting for the client.

items.text: Schwab began the rollout of 'portfolio insights,' an AI-enabled experience delivering tailored insights about client investment portfolios, performance relative to indices, holdings news and proprietary research, to expand over 2026 to topics like concentration risk, asset allocation and technical indicators.
items.quote: we will begin the rollout of portfolio insights, an AI-enabled experience that will deliver tailored insights to our clients about their investment portfolios...

items.text: Capgemini's research describes the Advisory Agent (A³) solution accelerator and AI-powered next-best actions aligned to client goals, plus a semantic data layer unifying structured and unstructured data to surface real-time intelligence on life events, portfolio risks, cross-sell opportunities and at-risk relationships.
items.quote: AI-powered next-best actions aligned to client goals enable personalized experiences at scale...

items.text: Edward Jones is developing an end-to-end retirement plan management tool with AI-driven third-party administrator Aboon, integrated into the advisor workstation, covering the workplace retirement plan lifecycle from prospecting to plan servicing; Aboon Workplace is an AI-native platform letting advisors find and win retirement plans.
items.quote: RPMC will leverage Aboon Workplace, an AI-native platform that lets advisors find and win retirement plans all in one place

items.text: Morgan Stanley notes advisors send 'next best actions' to individual retail clients, with higher response rates than historically.
items.quote: advisors were sending next best actions to their individual retail clients. We've seen many more responses to that than we have historically

items.text: Schwab describes leveraging artificial intelligence to strengthen operational excellence and drive advisor success through delivering AI-powered advisor intelligence and enabling an open AI ecosystem.
items.quote: Delivering AIPowered Advisor Intelligence... Enabling an Open AI Ecosystem... Accelerate open architecture & FinTech collaborations

items.text: Morgan Stanley's CEO says technology can help do a lot of the early work for decisions clients make with their financial advisers on complex financial needs (parents, kids, philanthropy, taxes).
items.quote: that is something that technology can help do a lot of the early work.

cells.reason: The passages describe numerous specific tools and capabilities (AI tools, agents, workstations, next-best actions, insights) that advisors will use to deliver advice, each a distinct statement attributable to a firm.
